title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One Azerbaijan Grand Prix?
background: The Azerbaijan Grand Prix is a Formula One race held on the Baku street circuit.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The official FIA race classification for the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix, corroborated by contemporary race reporting. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the driver classified as the race winner when the official race result is published. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning driver's full name.
